failures.actual: Four PASS role labels with no report_ref count clean and put nulls in evidence_refs. Separate old-run/old-version observations are accepted for a new run and stamped with the current version digest; they also count clean.
failures.expected: Recorded conclusions must refer to the applicable executor/run and review attempt and retain actual evidence-version provenance; missing final report sources cannot establish clean.
failures.minimal_fix: Validate the existing completion handoff once on intake. Preserve source-bound run/review-attempt/version rather than inferring them from current receipt time. Treat missing/unread/unbound evidence as diagnostic non-clean, not an authorization or human sign-off step.
failures.scope: Pure synthetic accepted observations, not a claim that actual users' four reviewer reports are false.

failures.root: Reconciliation attempt conflated with resolved charge
failures.actual: outcome=unknown changes entry.state to reconciled_unknown; pending_reconciles only includes state=unknown, so advice becomes dispatch_executor while cost remains null.
failures.expected: Unresolved possibly-paid calls remain unresolved across reconciliation attempts and crash recovery; unknown cannot infer safe redispatch.
failures.minimal_fix: Keep reconciliation-attempt metadata separate from resolution. All unresolved/null cost entries continue to produce reconciliation advice with resend=false; preserve costless work and existing cumulative ledger references.

failures.root: Age-based lock ownership and ABA release
failures.actual: A has a live current PID and owns its lock. Aging mtime by 31s lets B acquire with default stale=30; A.release deletes B's lock and C then acquires while B still owns it.
failures.expected: Read-check-replace must have mutual exclusion while a holder lives, and an old holder cannot release a replacement holder's lock.
failures.minimal_fix: Use a short-lived kernel lock with release-on-process-death, or an ownership-preserving equivalent. Age alone must never transfer a live critical section; no new permission/lease service.
failures.scope: Single process, multiple independent StateLock objects, mtime artificially aged to exercise the implemented expiry path; no actual 31-second pause, process kill or two concurrent commits claimed.

failures.root: Advisory output can overwrite live input/history
failures.actual: plan_observation(state, observation, state) returns exit0 and replaces audit-pool-progress/1 with audit-pool-plan/1. The state can no longer be loaded.
failures.expected: plan is read-only with respect to state and observation; a fresh output must not overwrite current inputs/history.
failures.minimal_fix: Create-only output artifacts with explicit input/output alias rejection and atomic publication; retain atomic replace only for the apply-owned state under its lock. This is file correctness, not a permission gate.

failures.actual: retest_done without evidence_ref invents 'unspecified', marks the old obligation done, and turns resume_remediation into campaign_sample_criteria_met.
failures.expected: An omitted result source cannot discharge required historical retesting.
failures.minimal_fix: Require the existing retest completion evidence to be source-bound/read before setting done. Preserve missing/unknown as diagnostics and an open obligation; do not add manual approval receipts.

limitations.impact: A harness strictly following suggested actions lacks an actionable final-close transition. It is a progress suggestion gap, not a false all-company-success claim.
limitations.action: ROOT can make final-close advice explicit while preserving the fixed action contract or updating it coherently.

limitations.actual: Four role keys are not evidence of four independent native agents by themselves. The module records observations; native harness/P7 execution and actual reviewer records must prove independence and research quality.

positive_checks: Pool exhaustion after only two clean entities produces no_action, not campaign_sample_criteria_met.
Unknown charges initially produce reconcile_possible_charge with resend=false and cost null.

The module proposes actions and does not launch agents/providers or introduce a separate ledger/manual authorization.
Pure reducer uses bounded reference state and input deep copies; source bytes stayed fixed.
